_comment: What Spark Welcome offers. Every id is a Flathub app id; nothing here is installed until the user ticks it and clicks Install. 'by' is whose app it is. French: name_fr, by_fr and blurb_fr (the English is used when one is left out).

launchers.name: Steam
launchers.blurb: The biggest PC game store. Runs most Windows games through Proton.
launchers.blurb_fr: Le plus grand magasin de jeux PC. Fait fonctionner la plupart des jeux Windows grâce à Proton.

launchers.name: Heroic
launchers.blurb: Your Epic Games, GOG and Amazon Prime Gaming libraries.
launchers.blurb_fr: Vos bibliothèques Epic Games, GOG et Amazon Prime Gaming.

launchers.name: Lutris
launchers.blurb: Battle.net, EA app, Ubisoft Connect and other launchers, set up by install scripts.
launchers.blurb_fr: Battle.net, l'application EA, Ubisoft Connect et d'autres lanceurs, installés par des scripts.

launchers.name: ProtonUp-Qt
launchers.blurb: Adds newer Proton and Wine builds to Steam, Heroic and Lutris, for games that need them.
launchers.blurb_fr: Ajoute des versions récentes de Proton et de Wine à Steam, Heroic et Lutris, pour les jeux qui en ont besoin.

apps.name: Discord
apps.blurb: Voice, video and text chat, mostly for gaming.
apps.blurb_fr: Clavardage vocal, vidéo et texte, surtout pour les jeux.

apps.name: Signal
apps.blurb: Encrypted messages and calls. Links to the Signal app on your phone.
apps.blurb_fr: Messages et appels chiffrés. Se relie à l'application Signal de votre téléphone.

apps.name: Spotify
apps.blurb: Music and podcasts streaming. Needs a Spotify account.
apps.blurb_fr: Musique et balados en continu. Demande un compte Spotify.

apps.name: Amazon Music
apps.blurb: Amazon has no Linux app: this adds Amazon Music to your menu, and it opens Amazon's web player in your browser. Needs an Amazon account.
apps.blurb_fr: Amazon n'a pas d'application Linux : ceci ajoute Amazon Music à votre menu, qui ouvre le lecteur web d'Amazon dans votre navigateur. Demande un compte Amazon.

apps.name: OBS Studio
apps.blurb: Record your screen or stream to Twitch and YouTube.
apps.blurb_fr: Enregistrez votre écran ou diffusez sur Twitch et YouTube.

apps.name: Bitwarden
apps.blurb: Password manager. Needs a Bitwarden account.
apps.blurb_fr: Gestionnaire de mots de passe. Demande un compte Bitwarden.
